_meta.note: Runtime strings. The canonical language is en; ja and zh mirror this exact key set, and tests/test_strings.py asserts that they do.

refusal.unknown_dof_start: no current position was supplied for degree of freedom {dof!r}
refusal.unknown_dof_limit: no limit was supplied for degree of freedom {dof!r}
refusal.target_outside_envelope: a target lies outside the envelope
refusal.unreachable_at_duration: reachability: for {dof}, no trapezoid in the family honours the velocity limit {limit} within {duration_ms} ms

pet_cli.description: Draw the Pet's face in the terminal. With --motion the motion runs too — ⛔ but it is sent to a mock, not to the machine
pet_cli.help_state: Draw one and exit. Without it, the five are cycled in order
pet_cli.help_motion: Run the intent in motions/<name>.json and draw the face from the same clock. ⚠️ The face is not --state: it is the expression of that name
pet_cli.help_interval: Seconds between frames while cycling. Default 1.5
pet_cli.help_sync: Use synchronised updates (CSI ? 2026 h/l). ⚠️ Whether the terminal supports it has not been measured, so it is off by default
pet_cli.help_lang: Language (en/ja/zh). Defaults to the EMBODIED_KINETIC_LOOM_LANG environment variable, or en

pet_report.refused:
{name}: ⛔ refused at plan time — {reason}
  ⇒ **not a single frame was sent.**
pet_report.head: {name}: {words}
pet_report.counts: sent {frames} frames, {ticks} ticks, the gate held {refusals} times, {skipped} ticks given up
pet_report.caveat: ⛔ not one limit was passed (all None) — nothing outside the envelope (190–833, measured) has rung
